problem: A GDI worker that dies mid-session made main.js drop to the Chromium path, which recreates its capture window: measured 5634ms in 3.11.10 (outputs/verify-2026-11-03/cold-exe).
change: On an unexpected worker exit during an ACTIVE session the agent now restarts the worker (max 2 attempts per session, 250ms delay, watchdog re-armed at 5s) and only then falls back to Chromium.

verdict.note: The max gap equals the normal 1 fps safety-frame cadence on a static desktop, so the restart is not user-visible: no 5s freeze, no Chromium keyframe, no geometry change.

worker_lifecycle.note: Replacement is a normal child of the agent and survives the session; the next session reuses it.
